title: [SOLVED] Crashes of QtWebEngineProcess (Falkon/Akonadi-EWS/KIO-Webdav)
body: Since the upgrade of qt6-webengine to 6.11.2-1 I am get crashes of QtWebEngineProcess trigger in: - Falkon by accessing certain webpages (e.g. https://k-report.net/ ), works just fine for others (e.g. https://bbs.archlinux.org/ ). There is a high CPU load for a while, then a standard "error when loading a webpage" appears together with: říj 07 11:11:24 asaborake systemd-coredump[58370]: [?] Process 58325 (QtWebEngineProc) of user 1000 dumped core. Stack trace of thread 1: #0 0x00007fe630313e69 n/a (n/a + 0x0) ELF object binary architecture: AMD x86-64 I supect theese are also related,as they started to appearch at that time: - Akonadi-EWS sometimes reporting <e-mail> source is damaged, hitting check e-mail in Kontact (once or twice) resumes normal operation, other times it just works normally, - Krusader KIO-Webdavs by accessing certain folders (some folders are listed ok, for other it hangs -- surprisingly, killing some kio_http.so process then causes folder listing to appear, same applies for copying files from webdavs). Deleting .cache did not help. These issues appear on all my Arch computers and also for all my users. KDE with X11. Is anyone experiencing the issue? Any ideas what to try? ( https://bugs.kde.org/ returns Forbidden...) Last edited by Nicky726 (Yesterday 19:39:00)
